mapper.select: select d.* from video_device d join video_device_channel ch on ch.device_id = d.device_id and ch.del_flag = '0' join video_platform_gb_channel rel on rel.device_channel_id = ch.channel_id and rel.del_flag = '0' where d.del_flag = '0' and rel.platform_id = #{platformId} and ch.channel_id = #{channelId}

select d.*, ch.channel_id as deviceId, ch.name as name from video_device d join video_device_channel ch on ch.device_id = d.device_id and ch.del_flag = '0' join video_platform_gb_channel rel on rel.device_channel_id = ch.channel_id and rel.del_flag = '0' where d.del_flag = '0' and rel.platform_id = #{platformId} and ch.channel_id = #{channelId}
